title: Public professional profile
description:
A person in their PUBLISHED PROFESSIONAL capacity only — a reporter's byline, an official's stated role, a researcher's affiliation.

The purpose is source analysis: knowing who reported a thing, what they usually cover, who they cited, and whether the piece was later corrected. That is what lets Archie weigh a claim. It is not a dossier on a human being.

The boundary is enforced by the schema rather than by good intentions. `additionalProperties` is false and the forbidden fields are named explicitly below, so a record carrying a home address or a phone number does not validate and cannot enter the store. A rule that lives only in a policy document is a rule that gets forgotten during an incident; this one fails a parse.

display_name.description: The name as published on their own work.

basis.description: Why this person is in the store at all. A profile exists because they published something under their own name in a professional capacity, or hold a public office. There is no other admissible basis.

public_evidence_url.description: A public URL demonstrating the basis. Required: without it, the record is an assertion about a person with nothing behind it.

affiliations.description: Publicly stated professional affiliations only, as the person or the outlet published them.

beats.description: Topics they demonstrably cover, derived from their own published work.

professional_accounts.description: Accounts the person or their employer has PUBLISHED as their professional contact — the handle printed on an author page. Never an account inferred, matched, or discovered by correlation.

published_at_url.description: The page where the person or outlet themselves published this handle. Its absence means the link was inferred, and inferred links are not recorded.

publication_record.description: What they have published and how it held up. This is the analytically useful part: a byline with three uncorrected pieces on a beat reads differently from one with a retraction.

corrections.description: Corrections and retractions the OUTLET issued. Recorded as the outlet stated them, never as Archie's characterisation.

primary_sources_cited.description: Named primary sources in their pieces. The most useful provenance signal there is: it distinguishes reporting from aggregation.

properties.$comment_no_scoring: There is deliberately no reliability or bias score. A single opaque number presented as a property of a journalist is a political act wearing a metric's clothes. What the model records instead is checkable: what they published, who they cited, and what was corrected. A reader can weigh that; nobody can argue with a 7.3.
properties.$comment_forbidden: The following are NEVER admissible and are excluded by additionalProperties:false — home or physical address, personal phone number, personal email, family members, relationships, date of birth, national identifiers, financial accounts, physical movements or travel, real-time location, private photographs, health information, and any field sourced from a breach, leak, or scraped private database. Archie's purpose here is source analysis, not personal targeting.
